title: NoElytraForYou
description: Replaces the Elytra with a custom made Item.
body:
This datapack replaces the Elytra with a custom made item that plays a random music disc when inserted in a juke box.

**The primary function of this datapack is to disable the elytra.
I added the item as a replacement so the End City boats don't feel so empty.**
